construction.implementation_origin: Original implementation written in the isolated build directory.

envelope.stage: input, research, documents, insights, or onboard.
envelope.questions: Nonempty array of {id, text, keywords}; keywords is a unique string array, possibly empty.
envelope.sources: Array of {id, title, text, kind, customer_id}; kind is reference or feedback. customer_id is null or a known customer ID. References must use null.
envelope.customers: Array of {id, name, goal, experience}; experience is beginner or experienced.
envelope.results: Initially empty; contains exactly the completed stage payloads.

shared_schema.output: One JSON object: {status: ok, data: validated final envelope}. File, JSON, usage, or validation errors produce {status: error, error: message} and exit 2.
shared_schema.validation: One shared validate function checks exact fields, bounded arrays and strings, unique IDs, valid types and references, evidence quotations and matching terms, document evidence coverage and checks, theme classification and coverage, sentiment counts, customer personalization and plan evidence lineage. Each stage validates its predecessor and its new envelope.
shared_schema.limits: At most 10000 entries per array and 20000 characters per nonempty string. Source and customer arrays may be empty. Explicit keywords must tokenize to searchable words.

cross_stage_handoffs.contract: Source-grounded sentence quotations, matched query tokens, source IDs, question IDs and unanswered question IDs. Documents consume only this validated evidence.

Normalized rows preserve source title, kind, customer identity, quote, word count, evidence IDs and question IDs. Same-source identical quotations collapse into one row so questions do not inflate feedback counts.

Ranked feedback themes carry row IDs, customer IDs, sentiment counts and actionable recommendations. Plans consume themes and validated document lineage, with customer goal and experience from the shared envelope.

behavior.research: Unicode-aware case-insensitive whole-token matching against explicit keywords or non-stopword question text. Sentence and newline splitting preserves exact source quotations. No match is recorded as an unanswered question, not invented evidence. Input source order is retained; relevance is lexical, not a truth or credibility judgment.
behavior.documents: Deduplicate by source ID and exact quotation, merge question and evidence lineage, count whitespace-delimited words, and validate evidence coverage and collapse counts. Distinct sources remain distinct.
behavior.insights: Only research-selected feedback rows contribute. Assign one theme by maximum lexicon overlap, breaking ties alphabetically. Themes: setup, usability, reliability, pricing, support, other. Positive and negative lexicons yield positive, negative, mixed or neutral sentiment. Rank themes by negative-plus-mixed row count, total row count and theme ID.
behavior.onboard: Create exactly one plan per customer. Select up to two personal themes in global priority order; otherwise use up to two shared themes; otherwise use goal-only steps. Customize introduction or pilot based on experience and preserve goal, name, theme and row provenance. Shared feedback is explicitly labeled and may include anonymous feedback.
behavior.determinism: No randomness, timestamps, network access or model calls. Input is not mutated; every handoff is deep-copied. Stable IDs and ordering produce identical output for identical input.
behavior.synthetic_data: All example customers, sources, quotations and goals are explicitly synthetic.
behavior.operation: The CLI reads one UTF-8 or UTF-8-BOM JSON file, emits JSON on stdout, and creates no files. Use -B to suppress bytecode artifacts.

included: Shared input and accumulated output envelope
Deduplicated document row extraction and checks
Standard-library tests and subprocess CLI checks
excluded: Live research, web retrieval, providers or optional LLM steps
PDF, office document or OCR parsing
Semantic entailment, source credibility scoring or fact verification
Negation-aware sentiment, sarcasm handling or multilingual theme lexicons
Feedback not selected by research question matching
Enterprise persistence, authentication, scheduling or external notifications

coverage: Exact evidence citations and unanswered questions
Whole-token keyword fallback and Unicode matching
Feedback-only insights, sentiment cases and unknown themes
Invalid schemas, duplicate IDs and dangling customer references
CLI success, missing files, malformed JSON, nonfinite numbers and invalid usage
